title: Metallorganische Verbindungen der Lanthanoide. LIII. (C5H5Gd)5(μ2-OCH3)4(μ3-OCH3)4(μ5-O) und [Na2(tC4H9OGd)4(μ3-OtC4H9)8(μ6-O)], zwei neue Alkoxigadoliniumcluster mit interstitiellem Sauerstoff

synthesis.procedure: All operations under dry, O2-free argon (Schlenk). To a suspension of 2.34 g (5.74 mmol) GdCl3(THF)2 in 50 mL THF was added dropwise 6.5 mL of 0.85 M cyclopentadienylsodium. After 2 h stirring at room temperature the mixture was cooled to −78 °C and a suspension of 0.62 g (11.48 mmol) NaOCH3 in 100 mL THF was added over 0.5 h. The mixture was allowed to warm slowly to room temperature and stirred for a further 15 h. The solvent was removed in vacuo and the glassy beige residue extracted with 100 mL diethyl ether. Removal of ether from the extract gave a white crystalline powder of 1. Colorless crystals; decomposition above 190 °C without melting. Interstitial oxygen is attributed to traces of water.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature, then −78 °C, then warm to room temperature
synthesis.time: 2 h at room temperature; NaOCH3 addition over 0.5 h; then 15 h at room temperature
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed in vacuo; residue extracted with 100 mL diethyl ether; ether removed to give white crystalline powder; crystals of 1 also contain diethyl ether of crystallization (CCDC formula C33H49Gd5O9·2(C4H10O))

source_locations.location: Röntgenstrukturanalysen; tetragonal pyramid of five Gd with interstitial O

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: 2.87 g (7.04 mmol) GdCl3(THF)2 was reacted with 3.8 mL of 1.85 M cyclopentadienylsodium and 1.41 g (14.08 mmol) potassium tert-butoxide in 250 mL THF under argon (Schlenk). After extraction with 100 mL diethyl ether, the ethereal solution was concentrated to 70 mL and cooled at −20 °C for 10 months, giving a colorless precipitate together with a few colorless crystals of 2. Characterization by single-crystal X-ray diffraction. The cluster is described as an adduct of Na2O to gadolinium tert-butoxide; interstitial oxygen attributed to traces of water.
synthesis.temperature: analogous to 1 (room temperature/−78 °C protocol implied); crystallization at −20 °C
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: extracted with 100 mL diethyl ether; concentrated to 70 mL; stored at −20 °C for 10 months to give colorless crystals
synthesis.yield: few colorless crystals (no numerical yield reported)
